encoding: m2-tagged-v1: no non-JSON type is needed here (decimals are strings, times are integer ns)

model_labels.approximate: approximate: European model on an American-style contract

note: Tenor rows. Each expiry: five strikes at 96,98,100,102,104 percent of spot, both rights, flat sigma a (put side a+shift), ATM IV = a + shift/2 exactly. Tenor IV = sqrt(w_t*365/t) with w_t linear in days between the two immediately bracketing LISTED expiries; an exact expiry is used as is; a bracketing expiry without an ATM strike gives no_bracketing_expiry (D14); an exact expiry without one gives its own reason. Tolerance IV 1e-4. Method names are the M1 names (as_is, variance_interpolation).
